set-variable.doc:name: Save Parameters

when.expression: #[sizeOf(vars.initialPayload.agreement.documents default []) > 0 and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.agreement.documents[0].container default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.agreement.documents[0].fileName default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.subscriber.documentType default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.subscriber.documentNumber default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.agreement.name default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.agreement.expirationDate default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.procedure.'type' default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.procedure.orderNumber default "")) and not isEmpty(trim(vars.initialPayload.procedure.user default ""))]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var p = vars.initialPayload var a = p.agreement var pr = p.procedure var docs = a.documents default [] var doc0 = docs[0] --- { "requiereCopiaAsesor": a.advisorCopyRequired default "0", "emailAsesor": a.advisorEmail, "usuario": pr.user, "fechaVencimientoAcuerdo": a.expirationDate, "destinatarios": (a.recipients default []) map ((r) -> { "email": r.email, "nombre": r.firstName, "apellido": r.lastName, "tipoDocumento": r.documentType, "numeroDocumento": r.documentNumber, "movil": r.mobile }), "mensajeCorreo": a.emailMessage, "documento": [ { "nombreDocumento": doc0.fileName, "contenidoDocumento": vars.documento, "tipoDocumento": doc0.mimeType default "application/pdf" } ] }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var fecha = now() >> "America/Bogota" var p = vars.initialPayload var a = p.agreement var pr = p.procedure var s = p.subscriber var rsp = vars.responseAZSign --- { TipoDocumento: s.documentType, NumeroDocumento: s.documentNumber, UsuarioEnvioAcuerdo: pr.user, FechaEnvio: fecha, NumeroOrden: pr.orderNumber, FirmantesAcuerdo: ((a.recipients default []) map ((r) -> (r.firstName default "") ++ " " ++ (r.lastName default "")) joinBy ", ") default "", EmailDestinatario: ((a.recipients default []) map ((r) -> r.email) joinBy ", ") default "", EmailCopia: a.advisorEmail, NumeroAcuerdo: rsp.AcuerdoRsp.AcuerdoId, NombreAcuerdo: rsp.AcuerdoRsp.AcuerdoNombre, TipoTramite: pr.'type', EstadoTramite: "En Tramite", FechaVencimientoTramite: rsp.AcuerdoRsp.Vencimiento, FechaRegistroTramite: fecha, FechaActualizacionTramite: fecha }
%dw 2.0 output application/json var r = vars.responseAZSign --- { responseCode: "500", response: ("Error: " ++ (r.Codigo default "") ++ " " ++ (r.Descripcion default "")) }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var pr = vars.initialPayload.procedure --- { "numero_solicitud_app": correlationId, "tipo_auditoria": "Insercion", "aplicacion": app.name, "iniciativa": "3505", "ip": vars.reqAttributes.headers.host default "", "navegador": "", "nombre_equipo": vars.reqAttributes.remoteAddress default "", "usuario": pr.user, "operacion": vars.reqAttributes.rawRequestUri default "", "resultado_operacion": payload.response default "", "fecha_solicitud": now() >> "America/Bogota" }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: 400, code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: { message: "Required fields missing: agreement.documents[0].container and fileName, subscriber, agreement.name and expirationDate, procedure.orderNumber, type and user" }, messageServer: "", cause: [] }
